rubrics.rubric: Does the submission provide all three requested deliverables as separate, usable documents for this production?
criterion: The submission includes a first-rehearsal call sheet for Tuesday, January 20, 2026.
The submission includes a day-one rehearsal setup memo.
The submission includes a reusable rehearsal report template for this production.

rubrics.rubric: Does the call sheet correctly identify the production, first-rehearsal date, and day-one venue?
criterion: The call sheet names the production as George Orwell's 1984 for the University of Rochester International Theatre Program.
The call sheet uses Tuesday, January 20, 2026 as the first-rehearsal date.
The call sheet identifies Todd Theatre in Todd Union as the day-one rehearsal location.

rubrics.rubric: Does the call sheet give actionable arrival logistics for the first rehearsal?
criterion: The call sheet names a concrete check-in point tied to the Todd Theatre lobby or lobby-side access.
The call sheet states when packet or script-copy distribution happens on arrival.
The arrival notes focus on first-night logistics such as where to go, where to wait, or where belongings and materials should be handled.

rubrics.rubric: Does the setup memo correctly state the SPAC building-hours and EMS constraints that affect scheduling?
criterion: The memo notes the standard SPAC building hours of 7:30 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. Monday through Friday.
The memo states that outside standard hours the building and room unlock 30 minutes before the EMS reservation start time and lock 30 minutes after the EMS reservation end time.
The memo states that event hours must be finalized in EMS no less than two weeks prior.

rubrics.rubric: Does the setup memo capture the SPAC support-space access and loading path that matter for the venue move?
criterion: The memo notes that the SPAC greenroom is in the basement across from the dressing rooms.
The memo notes that greenroom and dressing-room access runs through the lobby stairs, elevator, or backstage winding staircase.
The memo notes that loading goes through the scene shop and must be coordinated with the Operations Manager and scene shop manager.

rubrics.rubric: Does the setup memo identify the Smith Theatre room conditions that matter for advance planning?
criterion: The memo identifies Smith Theatre as a flexible black box with variable stage and seating layout.
The memo notes that entrances and exits are at the four corners, with the north wall on the lobby side and the south wall opening to the backstage hallway.
The memo notes that the storage doors under the technical or actor mezzanine on the north wall must remain accessible.

rubrics.rubric: Does the setup memo state the rehearsal-safety boundaries that apply in Smith Theatre?
criterion: The memo states that rehearsals should stay in the designated area.
The memo states that no one should enter the catwalk area unless it has been previously arranged.
The memo states that any catwalk access is treated as working at heights and requires qualified staff or faculty supervision.

rubrics.rubric: Does the setup memo include the greenroom-use caveats that matter for later SPAC planning?
criterion: The memo notes that the SPAC greenroom is used as a classroom until 5:00 p.m. Monday through Friday.
The memo notes that food, drinks, cups, plates, or similar service items for the greenroom are supplied by the end user rather than by the venue.
The memo notes that greenroom items should be labeled for the event or people and dated.

rubrics.rubric: Does the rehearsal report template include a department follow-up section that supports tracked action items?
criterion: The template includes a labeled department follow-up section.
The section supports department-specific action items for production areas such as scenic, props, costumes, lighting, sound, projection, or management.
The section includes a field for ownership, status, due date, or another concrete mechanism for tracking follow-up.

rubrics.rubric: Does the rehearsal report template include an accurate note about when the separate injury and near-miss report must be submitted or escalated?
criterion: The note states that every injury, near-miss, or accident during production work hours, including rehearsals, should be documented on the separate injury and near-miss report and submitted to the Production Manager.
The note states that any incident warranting hospitalization, emergency room service, or MERT intervention must also be submitted to the Artistic Director within one week of the incident.
The note states that the separate form should be signed by both the supervisor at the time and the injured party.
